body: Hi! I'd like to order a cake for my daughter's birthday party on Saturday the 12th. She's turning 7 and loves unicorns. Probably 20 kids plus some parents. Can we pick it up Saturday morning? Vanilla is safest with that age group.

Need a cake for a retirement party at the office. 10/4. About 40 people. Chocolate. No allergies to worry about this time. Half sheet should do it? Pickup Friday afternoon if possible, the party is Saturday.
do you do gluten free? my sister is celiac and it's her engagement party
Same as the one I ordered for Tyler's birthday in July but make it chocolate instead of lemon. Need it the 19th.
What are your hours on Labor Day weekend? Also do you deliver to Hillcrest?

Baby shower, October 11, 25-30 guests, lemon raspberry if you have it. Pickup the 10th. One thing - please make sure nothing with dairy touches it or goes near it. My son gets very sick and he'll be there. I can't stress this enough.
Hi, following up on my order from last week for the 20th, I never heard back on whether you could do the two tier. Just want to confirm it's in the book.
Cake for Sunday. Small-ish, maybe 20 people? Whatever you recommend flavor wise. Thanks
I want to order the same peanut butter cup cake we had for my husband's 40th, that was incredible. This time for our anniversary, October 3rd. Serves 12 or so. Pickup the 3rd before noon.
Order for 9/26, 8 inch round, red velvet with cream cheese, write 'Congratulations Dr. Markovich' on it. Pickup 4pm.
I have to cancel the cake for the 13th, my mother in law is in the hospital and we're postponing. Really sorry for the short notice.
Wedding cake consultation? We're getting married next June. Not ready to order, just want to know your pricing and if you book that far out.

Need a cake for the 18th. 60 people, it's a graduation. Two tier if you can. Funfetti for the bottom and vanilla for the top. My daughter is allergic to strawberries but she won't be at this one, she's away at school, so don't worry about that. Pickup morning of.
The cake for Saturday was dry and the buttercream tasted off. Really disappointed, we've been coming here for years. I'd like to talk to someone about it.
Actually can we make that unicorn cake funfetti instead of vanilla? And one of the moms asked about nuts - is there anything with nuts in it? A couple of the kids can't have them.
cake for the 25th, chocolate, 30 people, thanks

Hi there, we'd like a dessert table rather than a single cake - maybe 60 assorted pieces for an office event on 10/9. Is that something you do? If so what are the options and roughly what would it run?
Birthday cake for my dad, October 5. He's diabetic so we usually do something lower sugar for him but honestly he'll eat whatever, it's his 80th. 15 people. Carrot cake is his favorite.

Following up on the gluten free question. Engagement party is October 17, 35 people. If you can do it we'd want lemon. It has to be genuinely gluten free, not just 'no flour added' - she reacts badly. Pickup the 16th evening.
